name: "Strike Now!"
description:
*Your foe left an opening. You point this out to an ally!*

**Maneuver** — Ranged — Main action

**Distance:** Ranged 10   **Target:** One ally

**Effect:** The target can use a signature ability as a free triggered action. Spend 5 Focus: You target two allies instead of one.
